newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Japan's leading index seen above 50.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Japan's leading index seen above 50.

text.p: Japan's diffusion indices of leading economic indicators and coincident indicators in September are expected to rise above the "boom or bust" 50 mark after a fall below 50 in August, a Reuters poll of economic research institutions found.
A figure for the leading index above 50 is generally taken as suggesting the economy will expand in coming months. The figures are to be released at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Thursday.

The forecast for the leading indicators went as high as 60 against a preliminary 33.3 in August. All the institutions predicted that the coincident index would increase to 75 after a preliminary 30.0 in August.
Among components in the leading index, housing starts, inventory levels and the number of job offers had improved in September, while money supply worsened, economists said.
"It will be better, but things like production keep going up and down and it's hard to figure out a distinct direction (of the economy)," said an economist at Nikko Research.
